rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=25, recon_eta=1.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=214, train_n=0, rationale=iter-2 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon. ONE KNOB: recon_eta 30.0->1.0 (DPS guidance gain). iter-1 (eta=30) = SSIM 0.3937 / hr 0.0 / PSNR 14.31 / RMSE 0.00963 — FAR BELOW the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor, i.e. the recon is corrupted relative to its own FBP init, not merely prior-dominated drift. Failure mode: the DPS step is adaptively normalized in-solver (step = (eta/||resid||)*grad, Chung 2023 eq.12), so eta is a dimensionless gain whose literature/demo/breast default is 1.0; eta=30 (a discarded-614 boundary-metric hint) is a 30x overshoot that, with recon_eta_clamp=false (no per-step displacement cap), blows the FBP-initialized iterate off-manifold every reverse step, and the relax=1.0 hard-DC then re-noises a corrupted x0. HYPOTHESIS: lowering eta 30->1 lets the DPS correction be a gentle pull, recovering SSIM from 0.39 toward/above the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.39-0.5 (still <<FBP) at eta=1, the DPS step size was NOT the issue — the Mayo v4 DDPM prior is mismatched to rebinned Mayo under the 25-step low-T budget (mirrors the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict: globally faithful but not conditionally faithful under DPS/DC) -> iter-3 redirects to the prior, not the DC weight. BUDGET: eta is free (no per-slice cost change); iter-1 ran 214 slices in 1018.96 s = 4.76 s/slice = 17.0 min < 20-min wall (1800s in-solver backstop never hit). val=ALL 214 L277, 321px geometry FOV default.
